_comment: Deterministic post templates for build_queue.py. Adapted from the styles in new-post-templates.js (resort, trybeforebuy, roi, lifestyle2, rental) with all hardcoded figures removed: every number must come from properties.json through placeholders. Allowed placeholders: {name} {price} {neighborhood} {highlight_1} {highlight_2} {wa_link}. The {wa_link} placeholder must be the last line of every template (the wa.me link travels inside the message, never in the 'link' field). Style order defines the date-based rotation. Optional 'types' restricts a style to those property types (e.g. daily_life makes no sense for development land); build_queue advances to the next style when the day's property type is not allowed.
